title: Former Special Assistant to President Reagan, Doug Bandow:
text:
Former Special Assistant to President Reagan, Doug Bandow: "

"‘Donald Trump is probably afraid Iran has WON the war, but he CAN’T admit any of that, and he knows he needs to change that."

"And the only tool he imagines he has is to use the US Military. It didn’t work before, it's not working now."

"But Donald Trump is not one to check reality when his ego is at stake.’"

"Watch the full interview: https://lnkd.in/eR2n-afR
